statement: Each inbound provider message is processed at most once.
LID and canonical phone identities resolve consistently.
Message ordering cannot be silently reversed.
A stale AI plan cannot overwrite a newer turn.
Human mode does not silently return to bot mode.
One logical action creates at most one logical request.
Multiple legitimate requests remain distinguishable.
A coordinated request is not corrupted by a new request.
Donor facts never overwrite receiver facts.
Receiver facts never overwrite donor facts.
Self-move keeps distinct pickup and destination state.
Role-specific authorization is enforced.
Known city is retained and is not unnecessarily re-asked.
Known address and floor are retained in the correct side.
Known name, item, and quantity are retained.
Known media and counterparty identity are retained and linked.
Explicit approvals are retained and remain date-specific.
Direct handoff does not impose an unnecessary photo gate.
Recipient identity is linked and recipient approval is independent.
Open donation applies PHOTO-FIRST where required.
Condition, disassembly, and detail questions occur in the defined order.
Self-transfer keeps pickup and destination addresses and floors separate.
Self-transfer city inheritance is explicit and bounded.
Open request search and matching occur in the correct order.
Candidate interest and consent rules are respected.
Schedule approval is explicit and date-specific.
Changing a proposed date invalidates relevant approvals.
Capacity cannot be exceeded by concurrent requests.
Admin capacity approval is distinct from user consent.
Cancellation releases capacity correctly.
Business commit and Outbox creation are atomic.
Uncertain provider results are never blindly resent.
Provider acceptance is not mislabeled as delivered or read.
Retries do not duplicate completed external effects.
